passages.english: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.

lines.text: Long ago, God spoke.
God spoke to our fathers.
God spoke through the prophets.
Many times, God spoke to our fathers.
In many different ways, God spoke to our fathers.

passages.english: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.

lines.text: But in these last days, God has spoken.
God has spoken to us.
God has spoken to us by His Son, Jesus.
God appointed His Son as heir of all things.
God also made the universe through His Son.

passages.english: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.

lines.text: Jesus, the Son of God, became far greater than the angels.
The Son has inherited a name.
The Son's name is more excellent than the angels' names.

passages.english: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.

lines.text: Jesus, the Son of God, is the radiance of God's glory.
The Son is the exact representation of God's nature.
The Son upholds all things by His powerful word.
The Son provided purification for sins.
After this, the Son sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.

passages.english: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?

lines.text: God said to Jesus, "You are my Son."
God said to Jesus, "Today I have become Your Father."
God said again about Jesus, "I will be His Father."
God also said about Jesus, "He will be My Son."
God never said these words to any angel.

passages.english: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”

lines.text: God brings Jesus, His firstborn Son, into the world.
God says again about Jesus, "Let all God's angels worship Him."

passages.english: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”

lines.text: God speaks about the angels.
God makes His angels winds.
God makes His servants flames of fire.

passages.english: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

lines.text: But God speaks about Jesus, His Son.
God says to Jesus, "Your throne, O God, lasts forever and ever."
God says to Jesus, "Justice is the scepter of Your kingdom."

passages.english: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”

lines.text: God the Father is the God of Jesus.
God says to Jesus, "You have loved righteousness."
God says to Jesus, "You have hated wickedness."
So God the Father anointed Jesus.
God anointed Jesus with the oil of joy.
God anointed Jesus above all His companions.

passages.english: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

lines.text: God also says to Jesus, "You are Lord."
God says that in the beginning, Jesus laid the foundations of the earth.
God says the heavens are the work of Jesus' hands.

passages.english: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

lines.text: God says the heavens and the earth will perish.
God says to Jesus, "But You will remain."
God says all creation will wear out like an old garment.

passages.english: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”

lines.text: God says to Jesus, "You will roll up creation like a robe."
God says creation will be changed, like a garment.
God says to Jesus, "But You remain the same."
God says to Jesus, "Your years will never end."

passages.english: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?

lines.text: God says to Jesus, "Sit at My right hand."
God says to Jesus, "I will make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet."
God never said these words to any angel.

passages.english: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

lines.text: Angels are ministering spirits.
God sends angels to serve people.
These people will inherit salvation.
